paragraphs.text: Cards from Eldritch Moon compared to cards from earlier sets .
Assembled Alphas is strictly better than Inferno Elemental .
Blessed Alliance is strictly better than Sacred Nectar .
Borrowed Grace is strictly better than Fortify .
Certain Death is strictly better than Sip of Hemlock .
Chilling Grasp is strictly better than Frost Breath .
Docent of Perfection is strictly better than Air Elemental and Water Elemental .
Exultant Cultist is strictly better than Merfolk Seer .

Falkenrath Reaver is strictly better than Barbarian Outcast , Goblin Brigand , Goblin Bully , Goblin Elite Infantry , Goblin Firebug , Goblin Furrier , Goblin Hero , Goblin Mime , Goblin Piker , Goblin Raider , Gray Ogre , Hulking Goblin , Independent Troops , Ironclaw Orcs , Mad Dog , Mogg Jailer , Raging Bull , Reckless Cohort , Scarwood Goblins , Sell-Sword Brute , Skittish Kavu , Smoldering Efreet , and Yellow Scarves Troops .
Gnarlwood Dryad is strictly better than Sedge Scorpion .
Heron's Grace Champion is strictly better than Horned Cheetah and Zebra Unicorn .
Incendiary Flow is strictly better than Volcanic Hammer .
Ingenious Skaab is strictly better than Watercourser .
Kessig Prowler is strictly better than Jungle Lion and Mtenda Lion .
Niblis of Frost is strictly better than Hoverguard Observer , Ringwarden Owl , and Stronghold Zeppelin .
Noose Constrictor is strictly better than Grappler Spider .
Olivia's Dragoon is strictly better than Gutter Skulk and Walking Corpse .
Prophetic Ravings is strictly better than Epiphany Storm .
Selfless Spirit is strictly better than Lightwalker , Mistral Charger , Royal Falcon , and Stormfront Pegasus .
Spell Queller is strictly better than Talon Trooper .
Spirit of the Hunt is strictly better than Gnarled Mass and Trained Armodon .
Ulvenwald Observer is strictly better than Alpha Tyrranax , Canopy Gorger , Craw Wurm , Jerrard of the Closed Fist , Kindercatch , Torsten Von Ursus , and Tusked Colossodon .
Vildin-Pack Outcast is strictly better than Berserkers of Blood Ridge , Bonebreaker Giant , Flowstone Crusher , Fomori Nomad , and Obsidian Giant .
Cultist's Staff is strictly worse than Ghostfire Blade , Vulshok Morningstar and Warmonger's Chariot .
Displace is strictly worse than Ghostly Flicker .
Drag Under is strictly worse than Repulse .
Fortune's Favor is strictly worse than Fact or Fiction .
Take Inventory is strictly worse than Accumulated Knowledge .
Ironwright's Cleansing is strictly worse than Fate Forgotten and Revoke Existence .
